therapist_01.prompt:
The screen lights up. A voice, tired but warm, cuts through the ringing in your ears. Keys clacking somewhere behind it. "Got your intake up." A pause while he reads. {intake}
"You're still there? Good. I've got you until the top of the hour."
"See the three lighting up? Those are the ones you reach for. The rest are still there. You just don't pick them up much."
"So. How are you walking in today? Don't think about it. Just point."

truth.playerText: Not great. I woke up on the side of the road.
truth.npcReaction: "Okay. Thank you." The keys keep going; he types while you talk, the way you learn to with forty people on your caseload. "Look at the top of your screen. {cue:stability}Battery's how steady you're holding up. Let it run low and the people you call get tired of carrying you. {cue:trust}Bars are how connected people feel to you. Some people won't open up to you below a certain number. {cue:lucidity}Wi-Fi's how clearly you're seeing things. You need bars and Wi-Fi for a call to go through. {cue:integrity}And the clock keeps honest time, as long as you do. Lie enough and you'll watch the minutes skip." A beat. "Weather, not a verdict."

lie.npcReaction: "Fine." The keys don't stop. "Everyone's fine. My whole caseload is fine." A tired almost-laugh. "Top of your screen. {cue:stability}Battery: how steady. Run it down and your calls get heavy. {cue:trust}Bars: how connected. Some doors stay shut below a certain number. {cue:lucidity}Wi-Fi: how clear. No bars and Wi-Fi, no calls. They move whether you tell me the truth or not. {cue:integrity}And if the clock starts skipping, that one's on you." {mark:lake}A pause. "That reading at the bottom is the lake. FEELZ pulls it off the county sensors. It doesn't care how anybody feels."
lie.ledgerEntry: You told your therapist you were fine.

picks.Happy: "Bright. The sun doesn't ask permission either. Okay."
picks.Trust: "Open hands. Hard to hold anything that way. Hard to drop anything, too."
picks.Fear: "Small and quick. Like something under a porch. It can stay there a while."
picks.Surprise: "Caught mid-step. Most of life is. Okay."
picks.Sadness: "Low tide. It always comes back in."
picks.Disgust: "Something you'd rather spit out. Your body's smarter than your mouth. Noted."
picks.Anger: "That one runs hot. Hold it a second before you use it."
picks.Anxiety: "Braced already, and nothing's even happened yet. Okay."

therapist_intrusive.prompt: "Quick one, it's on the intake form." Keys. "Some people get thoughts that don't feel like theirs. Uninvited. Loud. Like somebody else got into the room. Ever happen to you?"

truth.playerText: Yeah. There's... a voice. Maybe two.
truth.npcReaction: "Okay. That's more common than people think. You don't have to argue with them. Just notice who's talking."

byPick.Trust: "You said that like you meant for me to hear it."
byPick.Fear: "You whispered that. You don't have to."
byPick.Sadness: "That sounded tired. Thank you for saying it anyway."
byPick.Disgust: "You said it like it tastes bad. It's allowed to."
byPick.Anxiety: "Breathe. You said it. It's out now."

byGift.Surprise: "Keep an eye on your wheel. Something you didn't see coming just came in with that. Everyone you meet is carrying a feeling you don't have yet."
byGift.Sadness: "Keep an eye on your wheel. Something heavy just came in with that. Everyone you meet is carrying a feeling you don't have yet."
byGift.Anxiety: "Keep an eye on your wheel. Something restless just came in with that. Everyone you meet is carrying a feeling you don't have yet."
byGift.none: "Your wheel's fuller than most. Still. Everyone you meet is carrying a feeling you don't have yet."

truth.itText: Great. Now you've ruined the fun.
truth.soText: Go ahead, tell him all about us. He won't believe you.

lie.npcReaction: "Okay. I'll check the box." A pause. "If that changes, it's not a failure. It's information. Some feelings only show up when you let someone see you."
lie.ledgerEntry: You told your therapist you don't hear voices.

byPick.Fear: "You said that fast. Like it might hear you."
byPick.Sadness: "That came out heavier than a no usually does."
byPick.Disgust: "You say it like it's a dirty question."
byPick.Anxiety: "Mm. Your knee's bouncing, by the way."

lie.soText: Good. Keep quiet about it. We'll keep quiet about you.

byClass.Bible: "This one's on the form. No wrong answer, I promise."
byClass.Crystals: "This one might feel weird. That's fine."

therapist_02.prompt: "One more, then I have to take my two o'clock." A beat. "What happened in the {color:Anxiety}dream{/color}?"

truth.playerText: I don't know. Water. Something underneath it. I couldn't breathe.
truth.npcReaction: A pause. Then, quieter: "Thank you. Most people give me the short version." A soft click, a chart opening. "That's the lake, at the bottom. FEELZ reads it off the county sensors. It doesn't care how you feel. It stays clear when you don't have to remember what you told people." A breath. "The fish were the county's idea. Somebody decided data needed a mascot."

lie.npcReaction: "Mm-hm." A pause just a beat too long. "We can leave it there. I'll write 'client deferred.' I write that a lot." Another soft click. "That's the lake, at the bottom. FEELZ reads it off the county sensors. It doesn't care how anyone feels about it. It just keeps count." A breath. "The fish were the county's idea. Watch the fish."
lie.ledgerEntry: You told your therapist you didn't remember the dream.

byClass.Guns: "Last one, then you can get back out there."
byClass.Crystals: "Last one. Let whatever comes up come up."

outro.text: "I give everyone homework. Almost nobody does it. Here's yours anyway."
"You're good at bracing. This week, try listening instead."
"You're good at showing up for people. Let someone show up for you."
"You feel everything in a room. Pick one person and stay with them."
"This week, ask one person a question about their day. Then wait for the answer. You don't have to fix anything. Just listen."
"Try getting curious about someone this week. Ask how they're doing, then ask a follow-up. People can tell when you mean it."
"Take an interest in somebody this week. Notice what they're doing and ask about it. Curiosity's a good place to start."
"People wear their weather on the outside. Listen for the word that doesn't match the face."
"{cue:scope}See the two lines across their picture? That's you and them. The closer the lines, the closer you are."
"{cue:instruments}The little screen beside them draws the two of you together. When it holds still, you're there. The needle leans right when you move as one."
"These talks get louder the longer they go. If you hear something new come in, something that wasn't there before, you're almost there with them."
"If someone shows you the door, listen to the last thing they say. People tell you what they needed on their way out."
"Get all the way in with someone and they might tell you why they are the way they are. Just listen. Don't fix it."
"You told me about the water. It heard you too."
"The dream can wait. Dreams are patient. Lakes are more patient."
"One more thing. See the bottom of your screen? That's me. Go on, tap it."
"Okay. You're calling me while I'm on the phone with you. Now there's two of me. Nobody needs two of me."

"When you're stuck out there, call. I'll tell you what I'm reading off you, and off them. If your bars and Wi-Fi drop too low, I won't pick up. That's not me ignoring you. That's you not letting anyone in."
"Make a real friend out there and they'll show up next to me. Everybody reads people their own way, so listen to how they put it. Doesn't mean they're right."
"And if your carrier goes from 5G down to No Service? That's the lake talking, not your phone."
"And I'll be straight with you. Out there, lying is going to feel good. Warm. Easy. Everybody smiles. I won't pretend it doesn't."
"Nobody stops you. The water just gets thicker. Your calls come in blurry, your friends lose track of your story, and it all comes due at the end."
"I'll have FEELZ send you a reminder, so you can't pretend you forgot."
{feel:Sadness}{mask:Happy}{want:miss}"Last thing, before I go. Pick any feeling on your wheel. Doesn't matter which. Watch the little screen beside me."
{feel:Anxiety}{mask:Happy}{want:miss}"Last thing, before I go. Pick any feeling on your wheel. Doesn't matter which. Watch the little screen beside me."
{feel:Anxiety}{mask:Happy}{want:miss}"Last thing, before I go. Pick any feeling on your wheel. Doesn't matter which. Watch the little screen beside me."
"See that? Not a circle. The further apart two feelings are on that wheel, the busier the shape gets."
"Technically, that's a Lissajous figure. Your feeling moves the dot side to side. Mine moves it up and down. Same speed, {cue:tone_unison}it draws a circle."

"Different speeds, and they keep missing each other, so the path tangles. Neighbors on the wheel are simple ratios, {cue:tone_fifth}like two notes in harmony. Opposites are the tritone, {cue:tone_tritone}the most restless interval in music."
"I don't own a gun. You're within your rights to, and I respect that. So: rifling. The spiral cut inside a barrel. Same twist, the grooves line up. Different twists, they never do. That's the knot."

"I'm not religious. I don't hold that against anyone, I want that on the record. But bear with me, I'm driven by data. Jacob wrestling the angel, plotted on graph paper. Two forces at right angles, all night. When they finally match, the blessing is a circle."

"My mom was into all that. Crystals, energy, the whole shelf. I didn't inherit it. But this I can explain to you with total confidence: two tuning forks, yours and mine. Same pitch, they hum one circle. Different pitch, the waveforms interfere. Waveforms. Not energies."
"And the needle on the left measures whether we rise and fall together. Leaning right, in step. Leaning left, mirror images, pulling apart."
"Leaning right, you're both aiming at the same target. Leaning left, you're aiming at each other. Please don't take that literally."
"Leaning right, you're praying for the same thing. Leaning left, for opposite things. Monks called that tritone the devil's interval. I call it Thursday."
"Leaning right, two auras in phase. Leaning left, out of phase. My mother would be thrilled. I need to stop talking."
{feel:Sadness}{mask:Happy}"Now. I've told you I'm fine all call. Watch my line: every few seconds another color flickers under it. That's the real one. Find it."
{feel:Anxiety}{mask:Happy}"Now. I've told you I'm fine all call. Watch my line: every few seconds another color flickers under it. That's the real one. Find it."
{feel:Anxiety}{mask:Happy}"Now. I've told you I'm fine all call. Watch my line: every few seconds another color flickers under it. That's the real one. Find it."
"There. A circle that holds still. My line said fine. The shape doesn't lie. People do that out there too, so read the color underneath."
"And the little blocks under it are what you've picked so far. Go find a few more."
The call ends mid-sentence, the way his calls do. FEELZ goes dark in your hand, and the lake is very quiet.

Listen a little longer than feels comfortable.

He's writing it down. Everything you said. Somewhere a file with your name on it just got thicker.
Or he hung up and forgot you already. Which would be worse?

Did he? Did you even lie? What was the dream again?
